name: Sameridine
summary: Sameridine (developmental code name LPB-139) is a 4-phenylpiperidine derivative that is related to the opioid analgesic drug pethidine (meperidine). It was under development as an anesthetic but was never marketed.

pharmacology.text: Sameridine has an unusual pharmacological profile, being both a local anaesthetic and a μ-opioid partial agonist.

uses.text: It was under development as an anesthetic but was never marketed. It is currently under development for use in surgical anasthesia, mainly administered by intrathecal infusion.

fact.en: Sameridine is unusual in doing two jobs at once: it is both an opioid and a local anaesthetic, and it was studied for injection into the spine during surgery.
fact.zh: Sameridine 的特別之處在於兼具兩種作用：它既是鴉片類藥物，也是局部麻醉劑，曾被研究用於手術時的脊椎注射。
fact.zhHans: Sameridine 的特别之处在于兼具两种作用：它既是鸦片类药物，也是局部麻醉剂，曾被研究用于手术时的脊椎注射。
